items.prompt: Kalimat mana yang memakai kata "borrow" dengan tepat?

visual.text: Can you borrow me your pencil?

choices.say: Can you borrow me your pencil?

visual.text: I borrowed my pencil to Dina.

choices.say: I borrowed my pencil to Dina.

visual.text: She borrows her sister a bike.

choices.say: She borrows her sister a bike.

items.reteach: Borrow = meminjam (kita yang menerima). Untuk meminjamkan kepada orang lain, pakai lend.

items.prompt: Kalimat mana yang memakai kata "lend" dengan tepat?

visual.text: Can you lend me your ruler?

choices.say: Can you lend me your ruler?

visual.text: I lent a book from Rudi.

choices.say: I lent a book from Rudi.

visual.text: Rudi lent a pen from me.

choices.say: Rudi lent a pen from me.

items.reteach: Lend = meminjamkan (kita yang memberi). Lend someone something: lend me your ruler.

items.prompt: Kalimat mana yang memakai kata "wear" dengan tepat?

visual.text: She wears a red hat today.

choices.say: She wears a red hat today.

visual.text: They wear the bus to school.

choices.say: They wear the bus to school.

items.reteach: Wear = memakai pakaian atau aksesori, seperti hat, shoes, glasses.

items.prompt: Kalimat mana yang memakai kata "heavy" dengan tepat?

visual.text: This box of books is too heavy to lift.

choices.say: This box of books is too heavy to lift.

visual.text: The cotton ball is too heavy to lift.

choices.say: The cotton ball is too heavy to lift.

visual.text: This soup is heavy to hear.

choices.say: This soup is heavy to hear.

visual.text: Her voice is heavy and blue.

choices.say: Her voice is heavy and blue.

items.reteach: Heavy = berat. Kotak berisi buku memang berat; kapas itu ringan.

items.prompt: Kalimat mana yang memakai kata "noisy" dengan tepat?

visual.text: The market is noisy in the morning.

choices.say: The market is noisy in the morning.

visual.text: The library is noisy because everyone is silent.

choices.say: The library is noisy because everyone is silent.

items.reteach: Noisy = ramai, berisik. Pasar pagi memang ramai suara.

items.prompt: Kalimat mana yang memakai kata "spend" dengan tepat?

visual.text: We spent the holiday in Malang.

choices.say: We spent the holiday in Malang.

visual.text: We spent the bus to Malang.

choices.say: We spent the bus to Malang.

visual.text: She spends a sandwich every day.

choices.say: She spends a sandwich every day.

items.reteach: Spend = menghabiskan (waktu atau uang): spend the holiday, spend money.

items.prompt: Kalimat mana yang memakai kata "early" dengan tepat?

visual.text: I woke up early to catch the first train.

choices.say: I woke up early to catch the first train.

visual.text: I woke up early, so I missed the first train.

choices.say: I woke up early, so I missed the first train.

visual.text: He is early because he came very late.

choices.say: He is early because he came very late.

items.reteach: Early = lebih awal. Bangun lebih awal supaya tidak ketinggalan kereta pertama.

items.prompt: Kalimat mana yang memakai kata "lose" dengan tepat?

visual.text: Don't lose your keys; keep them in your bag.

choices.say: Don't lose your keys; keep them in your bag.

visual.text: I lost my keys, so I can open the door now.

choices.say: I lost my keys, so I can open the door now.

visual.text: She loses her lunch to eat it.

choices.say: She loses her lunch to eat it.

visual.text: We lose the sun every morning.

choices.say: We lose the sun every morning.

items.reteach: Lose = kehilangan. Simpan kunci di tas supaya tidak hilang.

items.prompt: Kalimat mana yang memakai kata "hungry" dengan tepat?

visual.text: I am hungry, so I will eat now.

choices.say: I am hungry, so I will eat now.

visual.text: I am hungry because I have just eaten a big lunch.

choices.say: I am hungry because I have just eaten a big lunch.

visual.text: He is hungry, so he drinks medicine.

choices.say: He is hungry, so he drinks medicine.

items.reteach: Hungry = lapar. Kalau lapar, kita makan.

items.prompt: Kalimat mana yang memakai kata "tidy" dengan tepat?

visual.text: Please make your room tidy by throwing toys everywhere.

choices.say: Please make your room tidy by throwing toys everywhere.

visual.text: The tidy is under the bed.

choices.say: The tidy is under the bed.

items.reteach: Tidy = rapi. Keep your room tidy = jaga kamarmu tetap rapi.

items.prompt: Kalimat mana yang memakai kata "sharp" dengan tepat?

visual.text: Be careful, the knife is sharp.

choices.say: Be careful, the knife is sharp.

visual.text: Be careful, the pillow is sharp.

choices.say: Be careful, the pillow is sharp.

items.reteach: Sharp = tajam. Pisau itu tajam, bantal itu empuk.

items.prompt: Kalimat mana yang memakai kata "sick" dengan tepat?

visual.text: Dodi is sick, so he goes to the doctor.

choices.say: Dodi is sick, so he goes to the doctor.

visual.text: Dodi is sick, so he goes to the barber.

choices.say: Dodi is sick, so he goes to the barber.

visual.text: Dodi is sick, so he plays football all day.

choices.say: Dodi is sick, so he plays football all day.

items.reteach: Sick = sakit. Orang sakit pergi ke doctor, bukan ke barber (tukang cukur).

items.prompt: Bromo text: The word "active" means the volcano …

stimulus.text: Mount Bromo is an active volcano in East Java. Every morning, visitors climb a viewpoint to watch the sunrise. The view is breathtaking, and many people take photos.

items.reteach: Active volcano = gunung api yang masih bisa meletus.

items.prompt: Bromo text: "breathtaking" is closest in meaning to …

stimulus.text: Mount Bromo is an active volcano in East Java. Every morning, visitors climb a viewpoint to watch the sunrise. The view is breathtaking, and many people take photos.

items.reteach: Breathtaking = sangat indah sampai membuat kita terpukau.

items.prompt: Bromo text: Why do visitors climb the viewpoint in the morning?

stimulus.text: Mount Bromo is an active volcano in East Java. Every morning, visitors climb a viewpoint to watch the sunrise. The view is breathtaking, and many people take photos.

items.reteach: Bacaan menyebut: visitors climb a viewpoint to watch the sunrise.

items.prompt: Lina text: The word "thrifty" means …

stimulus.text: Lina is a thrifty girl. She rarely spends her pocket money on snacks. She saves it in a piggy bank. Last month, she finally bought a new bicycle.

items.reteach: Thrifty = hemat. Buktinya Lina jarang jajan dan menabung.

items.prompt: Lina text: The word "it" in the third sentence refers to …

stimulus.text: Lina is a thrifty girl. She rarely spends her pocket money on snacks. She saves it in a piggy bank. Last month, she finally bought a new bicycle.

items.reteach: She saves it = dia menabung uang sakunya.

items.prompt: Lina text: The word "finally" shows that Lina …

stimulus.text: Lina is a thrifty girl. She rarely spends her pocket money on snacks. She saves it in a piggy bank. Last month, she finally bought a new bicycle.

items.reteach: Finally = akhirnya, setelah menunggu atau berusaha lama.

items.prompt: Pool notice: "accompanied" means …

stimulus.text: NOTICE: The swimming pool is closed on Monday for cleaning. Visitors may use the pool again on Tuesday at 7 a.m. Children under 10 must be accompanied by an adult.

items.reteach: Accompanied by an adult = ditemani orang dewasa.

items.prompt: Pool notice: Why is the pool closed on Monday?

stimulus.text: NOTICE: The swimming pool is closed on Monday for cleaning. Visitors may use the pool again on Tuesday at 7 a.m. Children under 10 must be accompanied by an adult.

items.reteach: Closed on Monday for cleaning = tutup hari Senin untuk dibersihkan.

items.prompt: Pool notice: Who may NOT swim without an adult?

stimulus.text: NOTICE: The swimming pool is closed on Monday for cleaning. Visitors may use the pool again on Tuesday at 7 a.m. Children under 10 must be accompanied by an adult.

items.reteach: Children under 10 (di bawah 10 tahun) harus ditemani orang dewasa.

items.prompt: Batu text: "fertile" soil is soil that …

stimulus.text: The farmers in Batu grow apples on the hillside. The soil there is fertile and the air is cool. In the harvest season, tourists come to pick apples themselves.

items.reteach: Fertile = subur, tanaman tumbuh baik.

items.prompt: Batu text: "harvest season" is the time when …

stimulus.text: The farmers in Batu grow apples on the hillside. The soil there is fertile and the air is cool. In the harvest season, tourists come to pick apples themselves.

items.reteach: Harvest = panen, saatnya memetik hasil kebun.

items.prompt: Batu text: The word "themselves" refers to …

stimulus.text: The farmers in Batu grow apples on the hillside. The soil there is fertile and the air is cool. In the harvest season, tourists come to pick apples themselves.

items.reteach: Tourists come to pick apples themselves = para turis memetik apel sendiri.

items.prompt: At the market in Surabaya: "How much are these mangoes?" "They are ten thousand rupiah a ___."
items.reteach: Buah dijual per kilo. Litre untuk cairan, metre untuk panjang.

items.prompt: Ani: "My bike has a flat tyre." Budi: "Let's take it to the ___."
items.reteach: Ban kempis diperbaiki di repair shop (bengkel).

items.prompt: Doctor: "What's the matter?" Rudi: "I have a ___. My head hurts."
items.reteach: Head = kepala, ache = sakit. Headache = sakit kepala.

items.prompt: Waiter: "What would you like to drink?" Sita: "A glass of ___, please."
items.reteach: Yang diminum dari gelas adalah orange juice.

items.prompt: Teacher: "Please ___ the board, Dimas." Dimas: "Yes, Ma'am. I'll use the eraser."
items.reteach: Penghapus (eraser) dipakai untuk membersihkan papan.

items.prompt: Mother: "It's very dark in here." Son: "I'll switch on the ___."
items.reteach: Gelap? Nyalakan lamp (lampu).

items.prompt: On the beach in Madura: "Look at those big ___ crashing on the shore!"
items.reteach: Waves = ombak yang menghantam pantai.

items.prompt: Librarian: "You must ___ this book in two weeks." Student: "Yes, I will."
items.reteach: Return = mengembalikan buku ke perpustakaan.

items.prompt: Rina: "Your drawing is beautiful!" Tono: "Thank you for the ___."
items.reteach: Compliment = pujian. Complaint = keluhan.

items.prompt: Pilot: "Please fasten your ___. We are landing soon."
items.reteach: Fasten your seat belt = pasang sabuk pengaman.

items.prompt: Ticket officer at Gubeng Station: "Your train leaves from ___ 3."
items.reteach: Kereta berangkat dari platform (peron). Runway untuk pesawat.

items.prompt: Grandma: "It's raining heavily." You: "Don't forget your ___ when you go out."
items.reteach: Saat hujan deras kita memakai raincoat (jas hujan).

items.prompt: Susun huruf acak menjadi kata yang artinya "perpustakaan": R – A – Y – L – I – B – R
items.reteach: Library dieja L-I-B-R-A-R-Y.

items.prompt: Susun huruf acak menjadi kata yang artinya "cantik": T – U – A – B – E – L – F – I – U
items.reteach: Beautiful dieja B-E-A-U-T-I-F-U-L.

items.prompt: Susun huruf acak menjadi kata yang artinya "payung": L – U – M – E – B – R – L – A
items.reteach: Umbrella dieja U-M-B-R-E-L-L-A, dengan dua L.

items.prompt: Susun huruf acak menjadi kata yang artinya "sayuran": G – E – V – E – T – A – B – L – E
items.reteach: Vegetable dieja V-E-G-E-T-A-B-L-E.

items.prompt: Susun huruf acak menjadi kata yang artinya "rumah sakit": P – O – S – H – I – T – A – L
items.reteach: Hospital dieja H-O-S-P-I-T-A-L.

items.prompt: Susun huruf acak menjadi nama bulan kedua: R – U – B – E – F – A – R – Y
items.reteach: February dieja F-E-B-R-U-A-R-Y.

items.prompt: Susun huruf acak menjadi kata yang artinya "rumah makan": T – S – A – R – E – U – R – A – N – T
items.reteach: Restaurant dieja R-E-S-T-A-U-R-A-N-T.

items.prompt: Susun huruf acak menjadi nama hari Rabu: N – E – W – D – S – E – D – A – Y
items.reteach: Wednesday dieja W-E-D-N-E-S-D-A-Y; huruf d pertama tidak dibaca.

items.prompt: Susun huruf acak menjadi kata yang artinya "gunting": S – S – O – C – I – S – R – S
items.reteach: Scissors dieja S-C-I-S-S-O-R-S.

items.prompt: Susun huruf acak menjadi kata yang artinya "lezat": C – I – O – U – S – D – E – L – I
items.reteach: Delicious dieja D-E-L-I-C-I-O-U-S.

items.prompt: Susun huruf acak menjadi kata yang artinya "amplop": P – E – N – V – E – L – O – E
items.reteach: Envelope dieja E-N-V-E-L-O-P-E.

items.prompt: Susun huruf acak menjadi kata yang artinya "seribu": D – S – A – N – O – T – U – H
items.reteach: Thousand dieja T-H-O-U-S-A-N-D.

items.prompt: Odd one out (which word does NOT belong): kettle, frying pan, stove, pillow
items.reteach: Kettle, frying pan, dan stove ada di dapur. Pillow (bantal) ada di kamar tidur.

items.prompt: Analogy: hot is to cold as early is to …
items.reteach: Hot lawan cold, jadi early (awal) lawan late (terlambat).

items.prompt: Riddle: I have keys, but I cannot open doors. You press me to type. What am I?
items.reteach: Keyboard punya keys (tombol) yang ditekan untuk mengetik.

items.prompt: Riddle: I am full of water, but I am not a cup. You can swim in me at a hotel. What am I?
items.reteach: Kita bisa berenang di swimming pool.

items.prompt: Code: A = 1, B = 2, C = 3 … The word 3-1-20 is …
items.reteach: C = 3, A = 1, T = 20. Jadi CAT.

items.prompt: Analogy: pilot is to plane as captain is to …
items.reteach: Pilot mengemudikan pesawat, captain (nakhoda) memimpin kapal.

items.prompt: Change ONE letter of "BOOK" to make a word for a person who makes food.
items.reteach: Ganti B dengan C: BOOK menjadi COOK (juru masak).

items.prompt: Odd one out: happy, cheerful, glad, gloomy
items.reteach: Happy, cheerful, glad artinya senang. Gloomy artinya murung.

items.prompt: Which word can go before "ache", "brush" and "paste"?
items.reteach: Toothache (sakit gigi), toothbrush (sikat gigi), toothpaste (pasta gigi).

items.prompt: Analogy: finger is to hand as toe is to …
items.reteach: Finger (jari tangan) ada di hand, toe (jari kaki) ada di foot.

items.prompt: Riddle: Today is Friday. What day was it the day before yesterday?
items.reteach: Yesterday = Kamis, the day before yesterday = Rabu (Wednesday).

items.prompt: Code: each letter moves one step back in the alphabet. "EPH" becomes …
items.reteach: E mundur jadi D, P jadi O, H jadi G. Jadi DOG.
